description: Facing work that should not block the response, leave able to add a queue and describe the backlog the user can see. The queue is a fix for purge, reap, and unlink. It is not a place to hide the durable write.
line: Facing work that should not block the response, leave able to add a queue and describe the backlog the user can see.
title: Day 16 — Queue for work the user does not wait on
